If setting attributes succeeds, pass an [`FSItem.Attributes`](fsitem/attributes.md) with the item’s updated attributes and a `nil` error. If setting attributes fails, pass the relevant error as the second parameter; FSKit ignores any [`FSItem.Attributes`](fsitem/attributes.md) in this case.
